_comment: Fixture data shared by two consumers: scripts/seed_store.py pushes it into a real WooCommerce site, and api/local_store.py serves it in memory, which keeps the demo and the test suite in step. Each product exercises one code path, described in its note. All names, prices and people are invented.

products.note: Baseline simple product with a price, stock, a unit cost and complete copy. The default subject for pricing and listing tests.
products.name: Canvas tool apron
products.short_description: Waxed canvas apron with six pockets and cross-back straps.
products.description: A waxed 12 oz canvas apron with six pockets sized for a tape, pencils, a marking knife, and a phone. Cross-back cotton straps keep the weight off the neck through a long day at the bench. Machine washable in cold water; re-wax once a year.

products.note: Variable product with two variations at different prices and quantities. Exercises the parent/variation split: writes must target a variation id.
products.name: Folding step stool
products.short_description: Steel folding stool in two-step and three-step sizes.
products.description: A powder-coated steel folding stool that opens with one hand and locks flat for storage against a wall. Non-slip treads on every step. Rated to 150 kg. Two-step reaches 45 cm; three-step reaches 68 cm.

products.note: Sparse listing with almost no stock. Triggers the low-stock alert and the poor content-quality verdict.
products.name: Bench dog set

products.note: Post status draft, i.e. what a pause writes. Hidden from shoppers but must still appear in the merchant catalog as paused.
products.name: Shop stool cushion
products.short_description: Closed-cell foam cushion with a tie-on cover.
products.description: A 30 cm round closed-cell foam cushion with a waxed canvas cover and four ties to fit most round shop stools. Wipes clean.

products.note: No cost-of-goods value. Margin has to come back as None rather than 100%.
products.name: Layout square
products.description: A 300 mm machined aluminium layout square with etched metric and imperial scales, a scribing edge, and a lipped fence for marking across a board edge. Square to 0.1 mm over its length.

products.note: manage_stock is off. There is no quantity to increment, so a restock must be rejected.
products.name: Sawdust broom
products.short_description: Soft-bristle bench broom with a hardwood handle.
products.description: A 25 cm soft horsehair bench broom on a turned hardwood handle for sweeping shavings off the bench without scattering them. Hangs from a leather loop.

products.note: Plenty of stock and zero units sold in the last 30 days: the slow-mover alert case.
products.name: Cast iron hold-down
products.short_description: Cast iron hold-down clamp for a 19 mm dog hole.
products.description: A 20 cm cast iron hold-down that seats in a 19 mm dog hole and clamps stock to the bench top with a tap of a mallet. Machined pad, no marring. Sold singly.

products.note: Sits in the trash. The catalog read must exclude it, exactly as the storefront would.
products.name: Discontinued mallet
products.short_description: A mallet the store no longer sells.

orders.note: Paid one day ago and still processing; within the SLA so not flagged.
Open order with a customer_note, which becomes a buyer_message issue.
orders.customer_note: Please leave the parcel with the neighbour at number 12 if nobody answers — and could you add a spare set of straps if you have them?

orders.note: Processing for five days, past the SLA: produces the delayed issue.
Fully refunded; together with the following order it pushes bench-dog-set over the return-spike threshold.
Second refund for the same product.
